events.summary: Terrent Amese creates Ur-Drago by merging a tortoise, a white-maned horse and a black bull to punish Ojanen's people.
events.quote: was created by the planeswalker Terrent Amese around 2600 AR

events.summary: Ojanen duels Ur-Drago at the Tabernacle while the tribe flees Scarwood in the exodus.
events.quote: took on the beast in one-on-one combat in the halls of the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale

events.summary: Jedit Ojanen, magically transported to that moment, defeats Ur-Drago.
events.quote: Jedit Ojanen was magically transported to this crucial point in time and defeated Ur-Drago himself

events.summary: Leechnip summons a mana construct of Ur-Drago in Towser's attack on Greensleeves' Grove; Greensleeves banishes it to the Abyss at heavy cost.
events.quote: Greensleeves was successful in banishing the creature to the Abyss

relations.quote: was created by the planeswalker Terrent Amese
Ur-Drago was killed in his battle with Jedit
